SELECT audit_findings.id 
FROM audit_findings 
WHERE audit_findings.project_id = %(project_id_1)s::UUID AND audit_findings.target_type = %(target_type_1)s::VARCHAR AND audit_findings.target_id = %(target_id_1)s::UUID ORDER BY audit_findings.created_at, audit_findings.id

SELECT audit_findings.id AS audit_findings_id, audit_findings.project_id AS audit_findings_project_id, audit_findings.finding_type AS audit_findings_finding_type, audit_findings.severity AS audit_findings_severity, audit_findings.title AS audit_findings_title, audit_findings.description AS audit_findings_description, audit_findings.target_type AS audit_findings_target_type, audit_findings.target_id AS audit_findings_target_id, audit_findings.target_content_hash AS audit_findings_target_content_hash, audit_findings.status AS audit_findings_status, audit_findings.created_by AS audit_findings_created_by, audit_findings.created_at AS audit_findings_created_at, audit_findings.row_version AS audit_findings_row_version 
FROM audit_findings 
WHERE audit_findings.id = %(pk_1)s::UUID

SELECT claim_versions.id AS claim_versions_id, claim_versions.claim_id AS claim_versions_claim_id, claim_versions.version_number AS claim_versions_version_number, claim_versions.status AS claim_versions_status, claim_versions.statement AS claim_versions_statement, claim_versions.scope AS claim_versions_scope, claim_versions.qualification AS claim_versions_qualification, claim_versions.support_set_hash AS claim_versions_support_set_hash, claim_versions.content_hash AS claim_versions_content_hash, claim_versions.created_by AS claim_versions_created_by, claim_versions.created_at AS claim_versions_created_at, claim_versions.frozen_at AS claim_versions_frozen_at, claim_versions.row_version AS claim_versions_row_version 
FROM claim_versions 
WHERE claim_versions.id = %(pk_1)s::UUID

SELECT claims.id AS claims_id, claims.project_id AS claims_project_id, claims.current_version_id AS claims_current_version_id, claims.created_by AS claims_created_by, claims.created_at AS claims_created_at, claims.row_version AS claims_row_version

WHERE claims.id = %(pk_1)s::UUID

SELECT evidence_relations.id, evidence_relations.claim_version_id, evidence_relations.measurement_id, evidence_relations.statistical_result_id, evidence_relations.relation_type, evidence_relations.qualification, evidence_relations.created_by, evidence_relations.created_at 
FROM evidence_relations 
WHERE evidence_relations.claim_version_id = %(claim_version_id_1)s::UUID ORDER BY CASE WHEN (evidence_relations.measurement_id IS NOT NULL) THEN %(param_1)s::VARCHAR ELSE %(param_2)s::VARCHAR END, coalesce(evidence_relations.measurement_id, evidence_relations.statistical_result_id), evidence_relations.relation_type, evidence_relations.qualification ASC NULLS FIRST, evidence_relations.id
